[entity:person.noah] Noah's age (600, 7:6, 7:11) is not stored as a state, since time and age are derived by the linker.
[entity:substance.floodwaters] Defined as a substance entity because the plot turns on the waters; they act as agent in several events. Registry has no id for them.

[entity:group.animals_in_ark] New group for the animals taken into the ark, kept separate from the Genesis 1 groups (land animals, birds) since it is a selected subset. Birds are also linked to group.birds in the entry events and the death event.
[event_links:evt.gen_7.god_commands_entry] No place given: the text does not say where Noah is, so no event location. Same for noah_obeys, noah_enters_ark and all_enter_selfsame_day.
[event_links:evt.gen_7.god_commands_entry] Noah's household is not a separate entity here; the wife, sons and daughters-in-law are listed from the entry events onward.

[event_links:evt.gen_7.flood_begins] The verbs in 7:11 are passive, so God is not listed as agent in this event; the waters are. The judgment instance names the LORD as initiator because the story (6:13, 7:4) presents the flood as His act.
[component:comp.earth.condition.3] Inferred state: flooded begins at 7:10, closing condition.2 (ORDERED). It is not closed in this chapter; the waters recede in Gen 8.
[component:comp.humankind.survival.1] Inferred state. The earlier corruption state (comp.humankind.moral_state.1) is left open, since it is not stated to end here.
[system:sys.clean_and_unclean_animals] System defined here rather than reused; no earlier system covers the clean/unclean distinction.
[event_links:evt.gen_7.all_enter_selfsame_day] Verse 7:9 and 7:16 use Elohim; both are read as the same deity as the LORD (deity.yhwh), per the registry mapping.
[entity:person.noah] Noah's age (600, 7:6, 7:11) is not stored as a state, since time and age are derived by the linker.
